note: Hand-authored player-facing text for the public mod register. Everything not named here is composed by tools/build-public-register.py from the engineering register's own structured columns. NOTHING in this file is copied from the engineering register's prose: the owner's direction was 'all new writes'. 'extra' carries the two entries the engineering register never had, which is what takes the published list from 294 to the owner's 296.

extra.name: Rimbridge
extra.uses: Nothing directly. It is in the owner's own load order and is listed so the published list matches a real installation rather than a tidy one.
extra.without: Nothing at all. Rimrooms never touches it.
extra.watch: Not read in full. It arrived after the 294 were reviewed.

extra.name: Rimrooms - Async Industries
extra.uses: This is the mod this list is about.
extra.watch: Declares no hard dependency on anything below, and starts on its own.

4.uses: Everything. Every gate is one of Core's own doors, every cue falls back to a Core sound, and every object Rimrooms cannot supply is one Core already ships.

77.uses: Gates. A gate is a real door you designate, so a wider door from here can become a wider gate.
77.without: Nothing breaks. Gates up to three cells wide are still reachable by binding a run of ordinary Core doors side by side.
77.watch: Read and settled. Door sizes were checked against the gate footprints that exist.

273.uses: Who may walk through a gate. Rimrooms asks the door, so a lock here decides a crossing.
273.without: Nothing breaks. Zones and the door's own settings still decide who crosses.
273.watch: Read and settled. Prisoner and guest access were checked specifically, because a prisoner crossing is a door permission and nothing else.

148.uses: Nothing Rimrooms depends on. The company's own contracts live on their own board, not in the quest system.
148.without: Nothing changes. The Operations board is where company work comes from either way.
148.watch: Read and settled. Rimrooms deliberately keeps its contracts out of the quest system so this mod's filter cannot hide them.

49.watch: If you switch its breakdowns or solar flares off, gates still work. Nothing in a gate's progress waits on an incident this mod can suppress.

53.uses: Linking benches to the things that help them.
53.without: Nothing changes in play. Rimrooms names no bench of this mod's in any of its own code.
53.watch: Read. Rimrooms adds no second patch of its own for the same links.
